en.sayed-ali-raza: Part of the same sermon on the attentiveness of the people after the death of the Holy Prophet :

I looked and found that there is no supporter for me except my family, so I refrained from thrusting them unto death.I kept my eyes closed despite motes in them. I drank despite choking of throat. I exercised patience despite trouble in breathing and despite having to take sour colocynth as food.
